subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

BIND ∶ FFKH ∶∶ ROMP ∶ VLJT ∶∶ SPUN ∶ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is :

 
• First and fourth letters ⇒ (4) is added to the position value according English alphabetic series.
 
• Second and third letters ⇒ (3) is subtracted from the position value according English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• BIND ∶ FFKH

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ad39276655fc3fe26f928f25256dbb48be8b253277175be36f4eee6b0992134.png] 

And,

 
• ROMP ∶ VLJT

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3384636163344799dcba703da2524649008df48415bf69f8510b35eba5e16017.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• SPUN ∶ ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d115fcb7f1a4392284325045988bfcd802c1752fd3d317b9586dd24bb5a9cb7e.png] 

​Hence, "**WMRR**" is the correct answer.
